recent_articles.rephrased_article: A tri-corner contest is expected in the Nanguneri Assembly segment of Tamil Nadu, where **Congress**, **Amma Makkal Munnetra Kazhagam** and the newly formed **Tamilaga Vetri Kazhagam** are vying for victory. recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Omalur** constituency, located 15 km from Salem, has been a stronghold for the **AIADMK**, winning eight elections since 1977. recent_articles.rephrased_article: At least 404 candidates in the Tamil Nadu Assembly elections have declared serious criminal cases against them, according to a report released by **the Association for Democratic Reforms (ADR)** and **Tamil Nadu Election Watch (TNEW)**. recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Manamadurai Assembly constituency in Sivaganga district, known for its caste-based conflicts and police-inflicted torture incidents, has seen no significant development despite a DMK legislator. recent_articles.title: Tamil Nadu election 2026: Bhavani constituency faces infrastructure gaps, livelihood concerns - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Bhavani**, a town known for its handwoven jamakkalams and the Sangameswarar Temple, faces challenges in infrastructure development and declining traditional livelihoods. recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Residents** of the Chengalpattu Assembly Constituency in Tamil Nadu are expressing frustration over unfulfilled demands for infrastructure improvements, water resources management, and agricultural support. recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Thuraiyur (SC)** Assembly constituency in Tamil Nadu, predominantly agrarian and reserved for Scheduled Castes, faces persistent challenges despite its political significance.  **DMK**'s S. recent_articles.title: Tamil Nadu election 2026: Amaravathi sugar mill revival, drinking water issues dominate in Madathukulam constituency - The Hindu
